question.worked_solution:
We simplify each of the radical terms using the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{5}}+\sqrt[3]{54{t}^{2}} & = \\ t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{{t}^{3}\cdot 2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{27\cdot 2{t}^{2}} & = \\ t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{{t}^{3}\cdot 2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{{3}^{3}\cdot 2{t}^{2}} & = \\ t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{{t}^{3}}\cdot \sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+\sqrt[3]{{3}^{3}}\cdot \sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}} & = \\ t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+3\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}} & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we combine the like terms:

$$
\begin{aligned}t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+t\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}}+3\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}} & = \\ (t+t+3)\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}} & = \\ (2t+3)\sqrt[3]{2{t}^{2}} & \end{aligned}
$$
